name: Moodboards
original_description:
Turn a creative brief into a moodboard of five distinct visual directions, rendered as square images.

Describe what the moodboard is for (a brand, an interior, a fashion line, an event or a project) and the mood, colors, materials, era and style. The plugin prepares the request and shows the credits it will use. When you confirm, ManyMotions writes five different visual directions (subject, setting, light, palette and style) and renders each with two image models, for ten square images. A moodboard takes a few minutes; ChatGPT reports the progress and returns the links to the images.

For designers, brand teams, interior designers and event planners who need to agree on a look before they start.

Limitations: new images from a text brief only; it does not use uploaded or reference images. The directions are original: no brand logos, artworks or artists named as the style, copyrighted characters or real people. Producing a moodboard uses your signed-in ManyMotions account; preparing a request does not need an account.

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
